cases.caption: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
cases.action: something colliding with something and both come to a halt
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The car must be moving at high speed before impact.
The front end of the car must visibly crumple upon collision with the wall.
The car must come to a complete stop after the crash.
The impact must cause visible deformation of the wall or surrounding area.

cases.caption: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
cases.action: letting something roll up a slanted surface so it rolls back down
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The orange egg must be positioned at the base of the plastic slide for the rolling motion to begin.
The egg must roll upward along the curved surface of the slide, showing continuous motion.
The egg must reach the top of the slide and then roll back down the same path.
The egg must come to rest at the bottom of the slide, maintaining its position after the motion ends.

cases.caption: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
cases.action: pulling two ends of something so that it gets stretched
cases.first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: Two people must be positioned at opposite ends of the bungee cord to apply tension.
The cord must be stretched until it reaches its maximum elastic extension.
The cord should remain taut and fully extended without snapping or breaking.
The stretching action must be performed gradually to avoid sudden release or loss of control.

clauses.text: Ensure dough is soft and pliable before beginning to shape.
Apply even pressure with both hands to gradually round the dough into a smooth boule.
Keep work surface lightly dusted with flour to prevent sticking.
Continue shaping until the dough forms a uniform, round shape with a smooth surface.

cases.caption: A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.

Visible stretching and surface deformation must occur as the balloon inflates, indicating internal pressure.
The inflation process must continue until the balloon reaches a stable, fully inflated state without bursting.

settings.image_generator: native Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, one frame, no trained LoRA, no Planner
settings.image_prompt_template: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: {caption} Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.
settings.qwen_template: Given this initial image and the requested video, describe up to four short process requirements. Describe prerequisites, visible changes and continuation of existing results. Do not assign object IDs, boxes, masks, numerical forces or future timestamps. Do not invent unseen facts. Uncertain requirements may be omitted. Return JSON only: {"requirements": ["..."]}. Requested video:
settings.initial_noise: one FP32 CUDA noise tensor per case, persisted and cloned for both arms
settings.video_encoding: shared write_video: RGB lossless archive; baseline H264 yuv420p CRF18 for scoring

evaluation.average_definition: mean of (SA + PC) / 2; custom summary, not official Joint Score
evaluation.missing_policy: no final comparison unless every selected case has both valid SA and PC scores

scope: Fixed6 diagnostic subset of the existing videophy40 shared-first-image protocol

guidance.neutral: Same positive native T5 request, own image-only negative C
guidance.legacy_equivalence: Physical scale equal to text scale is exactly the original two-branch formula
